description: Duplicate prevention verified through the GUI on the REAL database (nobara-pc, MySQL 8.0.33 RoseProductionDB with the 4 new UNIQUE constraints), new code served on http://127.0.0.1:7004 (API 1.2.0, bundle /app/assets/index-57GBSTBk.js) started by scripts/apply_duplicate_fix.sh. Driven in the Claude desktop app's browser pane through the GUI's own forms and buttons (DOM events); every GUI request was logged by wrapping window.fetch; checks read the API in separate requests. All test rows use the tag GUIDUP_174528 and were deleted at the end.

steps.step: Clean-up of every test row (16 deletes, children first) and comparison with the baseline snapshot of all 7 tables

not_in_gui_log: Requests sent directly to the API from the test script (varieties 296, 297, 298 created to simulate duplicates the page cannot see; the API-direct harvest attempt of RG-17; the 16 clean-up DELETEs).
limitations: Controls were operated with DOM events, not OS-level input; Playwright (replica) covers the same flows with real browser input.
Persistence was checked with API reads; direct SQL counts for the same rules on the real database are in ../host/20261123_124335 (pytest and audit harness).
